plan.title: Scholarship Applications Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of scholarship applications and key metrics for the board

panels.title: Total Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Approved Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Approved'

panels.title: Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Approval Rate by Category
panels.sql: SELECT Category, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS rate FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Approved' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 10 Schemes by Applications
panels.sql: SELECT "Name of scheme", COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
